```yaml
name: ADR Agent
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]

jobs:
  validate-adrs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json

      - name: Check for architecturally significant changes
        id: check-significant
        run: |
          CHANGED_FILES=$(echo '${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all }}' | jq -r '.[]')
          SIGNIFICANT=false
          
          for file in $CHANGED_FILES; do
            if [[ "$file" == "docs/adr/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == ".github/workflows/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == ".github/agents/"* ]]; then
              SIGNIFICANT=true
              break
            fi
          done
          
          echo "significant_changes=$SIGNIFICANT" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Validate ADRs with Copilot Agent
        if: env.significant_changes == 'true'
        uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
        with:
          model: gpt-4
          agent: .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
          prompt: |
            You are an expert software architect reviewing architectural decisions in a C++ firmware project.
            
            Context:
            - Repository: rvdbreemen/OTGW-firmware
            - Primary language: C++
            - This is a review of changes that may introduce new architectural decisions
            
            Task:
            1. Analyze the changed files to determine if they introduce new architectural decisions
            2. Check existing ADRs in docs/adr/ to ensure alignment
            3. If new ADRs are needed, generate them following the template in .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
            4. Follow ADR format, numbering, and status conventions in docs/adr/README.md
            5. Do NOT modify existing accepted ADRs; create superseding ADRs instead
            
            Files changed:
            ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all }}
            
            Please respond with either:
            - A list of new ADRs to create (if any)
            - A comment explaining why no new ADR is required
          use_github_token: true
          variant: copilot

      - name: Comment on PR if needed
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## ADR Review Required
            
            This pull request modifies architecturally significant files. The ADR validation process has been initiated.
            
            Please review the changes and ensure all architectural decisions are properly documented in `docs/adr/`.
            
            If new ADRs are required, they will be generated automatically.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          mode: create-if-not-exists
```
